Lore archive

The sign was only the first warning.

NO BALL GAMES can work as a full story world. The banned court, the blocked estate, the painted wall and the secret game all become part of the mythology.

Origin

The sign

A public warning designed to stop play becomes the central symbol of the brand.

Phase one

The wall

The message moves from sign to surface: tags, grime texture, characters, posters, stencils and coded marks.

Phase two

The players

Characters emerge from the restricted zones. Each one carries a different version of rebellion, humour, survival or creative defiance.

Phase three

The movement

The brand becomes a hub for collectors, artists, gamers, writers and supporters who understand the meaning behind the phrase.

World ingredients

Simple objects. Bigger meaning.

The lore should stay grounded in familiar British visual language: signs, fences, courts, alleyways, estate blocks, shutters, bus stops, school walls and concrete spaces.
